title: Restricted Area Entry Permit
name: Restricted Area Entry Permit
description: Permit for controlled entry to a restricted work area. It does not replace specialist permits such as confined space, electrical isolation, asbestos or work at height where those hazards apply.

fields.label: RAMS / Safe System of Work Reference

sections.title: ACCESS AUTHORITY AND AREA STATUS
items: The area owner / controller has authorised the planned entry
The purpose, scope and boundaries of the entry are clearly defined
The restricted area is not being treated as a substitute for a specialist permit where one is required
Current area conditions and simultaneous operations have been checked
Access restrictions, occupancy limits and prohibited activities have been briefed

sections.title: HAZARDS AND LINKED CONTROLS
items: Area-specific hazards have been identified and briefed to entrants
Required isolations and specialist permits are in place before entry
Changes in process, plant condition or neighbouring work will trigger reassessment
Required PPE / RPE has been selected for the actual hazards
Entrants understand what conditions require immediate withdrawal

sections.title: ENTRY CONTROL, SECURITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY
items: Only named and authorised persons will enter the restricted area
The approved entry point is controlled against unauthorised access
An entry / exit log or equivalent accountability method is in place
An escort is provided where the area rules require one
Tools, equipment and materials taken into the area are controlled and accounted for

fields.label: Entry / Exit Log Reference or Accountability Method
Tools / Equipment / Materials Taken Into Area

sections.title: COMMUNICATIONS AND EMERGENCY ARRANGEMENTS
items: A reliable communication method is available for the duration of entry
Entrants know how to raise an alarm and obtain assistance
Emergency exits and evacuation routes are known and unobstructed
Area-specific emergency arrangements have been briefed
The person in charge knows how entrants will be accounted for during an evacuation

sections.title: ENTRY, HANDOVER AND EXIT CONFIRMATION
items: The area condition is acceptable immediately before entry
All entrants have received the final briefing before entry
Entry conditions will be handed over if supervision changes
All entrants will sign / be recorded out when leaving
The area will be checked and secured when the authorised entry ends

fields.label: All Persons Out / Accounted For Confirmed By

sections.title: HAND-BACK AND CLOSE-OUT
items: All persons are confirmed out of the restricted area
Tools, equipment and materials are accounted for
Temporary controls have been removed or formally handed over
The entry point and restricted area have been returned to the area owner / controller
